meta.title: Partnerships — Daniel Oliver Racing
meta.description: Partner with Daniel Oliver for the 2026 IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge season. More than a logo on a car, we build a story together.

hero.intro: Partnering with Daniel means building a story together: an engineer-turned-racer taking a data-driven method to the 2026 IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge, and bringing students into the paddock along the way.

offers.title: Real value, on and off track

items.title: TV + digital exposure
items.body: IMSA weekends carry broadcast and streaming reach. Your brand rides on the car, the suit, and every frame of coverage.

items.title: Media production
items.body: Professional photo and video from every event. Content your marketing team can actually use, delivered race by race.

items.title: Trackside presence
items.body: Hospitality and paddock access at race weekends. Bring clients and teams inside the sport, not just in front of it.

items.title: A story worth telling
items.body: Sim-to-real, engineering-driven, no pedigree, plus Project Limit Break putting students inside an IMSA paddock. A narrative your audience remembers.

audience.title: A fanbase that follows the whole journey

stats.label: highly engaged fanbase following the journey across all platforms

limitBreak.title: Put students in the paddock with us
limitBreak.body: Through Limit Break Engineering, IMSA race weekends double as a student exposure program with young engineers working alongside strategists, mechanics and media crews. Partners don't just back a driver; they back the pipeline into motorsport.
limitBreak.imageAlt: Daniel Oliver with a group of Project Limit Break students in the race garage

media.title: Content, camera-ready
media.body: Bespoke partner shoots, podcast and broadcast appearances, live fan Q&As - the program produces professional media wherever the story goes, and partners ride along in all of it.
